cli.description: Stitches flat scanned images (no scale deformation) into one seamless TIFF. A Microsoft ICE equivalent for scanned documents on Linux.
cli.help.inputs: Image files, glob patterns (*.png), and/or folders of scans
cli.help.output: Path to the output TIFF. If omitted, saved as stitched.tiff (or stitched_2.tiff, ...) in the same folder as the first input scan.
cli.help.detector: Feature detector (sift is more accurate; orb is faster). Default: sift
cli.help.match_ratio: Lowe's ratio test threshold for filtering feature matches (0-1). Default: 0.75
cli.help.reproj_thresh: Allowed error (in pixels) during RANSAC search. Default: 3.0
cli.help.min_inliers: Minimum agreeing points to consider two scans linked. Default: 12
cli.help.downscale: Shrink images by this factor for feature search only (speeds up very large scans; has almost no effect on stitching quality). Default: 1.0 (no shrinking)
cli.help.sharpen_power: Sharpness of the seam transition (higher = narrower, sharper seam). Default: 6.0
cli.help.interpolation: Interpolation method when rotating scans. cubic - sharp, minimal halos around text/lines (default). lanczos4 is even sharper but produces visible ringing on high-contrast line art/text; linear - softest, no ringing at all.
cli.help.background: Fill for canvas areas no scan covers (usually just thin wedges at corners from rotation error). transparent (default) writes an alpha channel so they are see-through; white/black paint them instead.
cli.help.ref_index: Index of the image used as the fixed reference point. Default: 0
cli.help.jobs: Number of processes for parallel pairwise image matching (this is the part that grows as n^2 with scan count). Default: all available CPU cores. --jobs 1 disables parallelism.
cli.help.lang: Interface language. Default: auto-detected from the system locale.
cli.error.too_few_images: Found fewer than 2 images to stitch. Check the paths/folder.
cli.output_default: No output path given (-o) - will save as: {path}
pipeline.error.need_two_images: Need at least 2 images to stitch.
pipeline.log.loading_features: Loading {n} images and searching for features...
pipeline.error.no_matches: No pair of images could be matched. Check that neighboring scans actually overlap (~15-30%) and contain enough detail (lines/text) in the overlap area.
pipeline.warning.disconnected_groups: The images form {n} disconnected groups (sizes: {sizes}). This means no shared features were found between groups - check the overlap. Each group will be saved as a separate file.
pipeline.log.canvas_size: Canvas for group {i}: {w} x {h} px ({n} images)
pipeline.warning.gap_pixels: There are {pixels} pixels with no source coverage inside the stitched area ({percent}% of the canvas) - usually thin wedges at the edges from a slight scan rotation. If this is visible in the result, increase the overlap between neighboring scans.
io.log.bigtiff: Result is large - writing in BigTIFF format
features.warning.no_sift: SIFT is unavailable in this OpenCV build, using ORB instead

cli.help.no_auto_orient: Do not auto-rotate the finished sheet. By default the canvas is turned by a multiple of 90 degrees so most tiles come out the way they were scanned - useful when a sheet was placed sideways on the glass. This has no effect when all scans already agree.
